Title: 10 Garage Storage Ideas to Clear the Floor (Shelving, Hooks, Pegboard)
Description: Garage storage ideas that clear the floor: metal shelving with lidded boxes, bikes hung on wall hooks, a pegboard over a workbench and a garden tool rail. See a before and after of a crammed single garage, plus how much room is left when you park a car inside.
Keywords: garage storage ideas, garage organization, garage shelving

Title: Small Garage Storage: 10 Ideas for a Single Garage
Description: Small garage storage ideas for a single garage: hang bikes by the front wheel (about 30 cm of wall each), choose shelving rated per shelf, keep tools heads up on a rail and every hand tool on its own pegboard hook. Includes safe storage tips for paint, petrol and e-bikes.
Keywords: small garage storage ideas, garage bike storage ideas, garage organisation
